newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Mulia Industrindo says Q1 net down.
newsitem.headline: Mulia Industrindo says Q1 net down.

text.p: Indonesian glass and ceramics maker PT Mulia Industrindo said on Tuesday it posted a net profit of 16.0 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997, or down 6.8 billion rupiah from the year-ago period.
Mulia also said in a statement that the firm posted net sales of 128.4 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997, or up 17 percent from the year-ago period.
Mulia said the fall in net profit was due weak float glass prices which led to lower gross profit.
The firm said the increase in net sales was due to rises in sales volume of ceramics, float glass and glass blocks.
Mulia said the firm expected to commence exporting ceramics to the United States in June.
The firm also said it expected to start production of automotive safety glass in the third quarter of 1997.
The statement did not give further details. Officials of Mulia Industrindo were not immediately available for comment.
